import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
BLL=("MTMSLAPIRRVVTGHDAHGDAVIATDDALPTVVELAAIPGTIFHEVWSTAATPVSIDNGP"
     "DPTIGALRLPPPTHGTRIRFVDIPPDTEDFLKHGAARMKEAFSQVGDVHASTVRPDSPHP"
     "LMHRTETVDYGIVISGEITLVLDKSEANLKAGDVVIQRGTNHAWANRSGKPCRMLFMLVD"
     "GQFSDEVKPSRAGS")
flds="accession,protein_name,ec,cc_cofactor,sequence"
url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query="+requests.utils.quote("(xref:interpro-IPR011051) AND (reviewed:true)")+f"&format=json&size=500&fields={flds}")
res=[];r=requests.get(url,timeout=180);res+=r.json()["results"]
while r.links.get("next"):
    r=requests.get(r.links["next"]["url"],timeout=180);res+=r.json()["results"]
recs=[]
for e in res:
    rn=e.get("proteinDescription",{}).get("recommendedName",{})
    nm=rn.get("fullName",{}).get("value") or "?"
    cof=sorted({cc["name"] for c in e.get("comments",[]) if c.get("commentType")=="COFACTOR" for cc in c.get("cofactors",[])})
    s=e.get("sequence",{}).get("value","")
    if 20<len(s)<=400: recs.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],name=nm,ec=";".join(x["value"] for x in rn.get("ecNumbers",[])),cof=";".join(cof),seq=s))
N=len(recs); AAs="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62=np.array([[4,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-1,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,0,-3,-2,0],[-1,5,0,-2,-3,1,0,-2,0,-3,-2,2,-1,-3,-2,-1,-1,-3,-2,-3],[-2,0,6,1,-3,0,0,0,1,-3,-3,0,-2,-3,-2,1,0,-4,-2,-3],[-2,-2,1,6,-3,0,2,-1,-1,-3,-4,-1,-3,-3,-1,0,-1,-4,-3,-3],[0,-3,-3,-3,9,-3,-4,-3,-3,-1,-1,-3,-1,-2,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1],[-1,1,0,0,-3,5,2,-2,0,-3,-2,1,0,-3,-1,0,-1,-2,-1,-2],[-1,0,0,2,-4,2,5,-2,0,-3,-3,1,-2,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],[0,-2,0,-1,-3,-2,-2,6,-2,-4,-4,-2,-3,-3,-2,0,-2,-2,-3,-3],[-2,0,1,-1,-3,0,0,-2,8,-3,-3,-1,-2,-1,-2,-1,-2,-2,2,-3],[-1,-3,-3,-3,-1,-3,-3,-4,-3,4,2,-3,1,0,-3,-2,-1,-3,-1,3],[-1,-2,-3,-4,-1,-2,-3,-4,-3,2,4,-2,2,0,-3,-2,-1,-2,-1,1],[-1,2,0,-1,-3,1,1,-2,-1,-3,-2,5,-1,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],[-1,-1,-2,-3,-1,0,-2,-3,-2,1,2,-1,5,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,1],[-2,-3,-3,-3,-2,-3,-3,-3,-1,0,0,-3,0,6,-4,-2,-2,1,3,-1],[-1,-2,-2,-1,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,-1,-2,-4,7,-1,-1,-4,-3,-2],[1,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,0,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-2,-1,4,1,-3,-2,-2],[0,-1,0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,5,-2,-2,0],[-3,-3,-4,-4,-2,-2,-3,-2,-2,-3,-2,-3,-1,1,-4,-3,-2,11,2,-3],[-2,-2,-2,-3,-2,-1,-2,-3,2,-1,-1,-2,-1,3,-3,-2,-2,2,7,-1],[0,-3,-3,-3,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,3,1,-2,1,-1,-2,-2,0,-3,-1,4]],np.float32)
S=np.full((21,21),-4,np.float32);S[:20,:20]=B62
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}; enc=lambda s:np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s],np.int64)
L=max(len(x["seq"]) for x in recs); REF=np.full((N,L),20,np.int64); RLEN=np.zeros(N,int)
for i,x in enumerate(recs): e=enc(x["seq"]); REF[i,:len(e)]=e; RLEN[i]=len(e)
VALID=np.arange(L)[None,:]<RLEN[:,None]; GO,GE=11.,1.
def swb(q):
    qi=enc(q);Hp=np.zeros((N,L+1),np.float32);Fp=np.full((N,L+1),-1e9,np.float32);b=np.zeros(N,np.float32)
    for i in range(len(qi)):
        sr=np.where(VALID,S[qi[i]][REF],-1e9)
        Hc=np.zeros((N,L+1),np.float32);Fc=np.full((N,L+1),-1e9,np.float32);Ec=np.full(N,-1e9,np.float32)
        for j in range(1,L+1):
            Ec=np.maximum(Hc[:,j-1]-GO,Ec-GE);Fc[:,j]=np.maximum(Hp[:,j]-GO,Fp[:,j]-GE)
            h=np.maximum(np.maximum(Hp[:,j-1]+sr[:,j-1],Ec),Fc[:,j]);np.maximum(h,0,out=h);Hc[:,j]=h
        b=np.maximum(b,Hc.max(1));Hp,Fp=Hc,Fc
    return b
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);obs=swb(BLL);lst=list(BLL);nl=[]
for k in range(2):
    rng.shuffle(lst);nl.append(swb("".join(lst)))
nl=np.array(nl);x=np.log(RLEN);c=np.polyfit(np.tile(x,2),nl.reshape(-1),1)
mu=np.polyval(c,x);sd=(nl.reshape(-1)-np.polyval(c,np.tile(x,2))).std();z=(obs-mu)/sd
df=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=r_["acc"],name=r_["name"],ec=r_["ec"],cof=r_["cof"],z=float(z[i])) for i,r_ in enumerate(recs)]).sort_values("z",ascending=False)
df.to_csv("/tmp/bll6423_cupin_ranking.csv",index=False)

def cls(row):
    n=row["name"].lower()
    if "virc" in n or "ory" in n or "phomopsin" in n or "ascochitine" in n or "srd" in n or "fog" in n or "rus" in n: return "virC/oryJ clade (no cofactor)"
    if row["cof"]: return "metal-dependent cupin enzyme"
    if row["ec"]: return "cupin enzyme, no cofactor annotated"
    return "non-catalytic / unassigned cupin"
df["class"]=df.apply(cls,axis=1)
order=["virC/oryJ clade (no cofactor)","metal-dependent cupin enzyme","cupin enzyme, no cofactor annotated","non-catalytic / unassigned cupin"]
cols={"virC/oryJ clade (no cofactor)":"#C2410C","metal-dependent cupin enzyme":"#1D4ED8",
      "cupin enzyme, no cofactor annotated":"#0E7490","non-catalytic / unassigned cupin":"#9CA3AF"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.1,1.3]})
for i,k in enumerate(order):
    v=df[df["class"]==k]["z"].values
    ax[0].scatter(np.full(len(v),i)+rng.normal(0,.09,len(v)),v,s=14,alpha=.6,color=cols[k],edgecolor="none")
ax[0].axhline(3,ls="--",lw=1,color="k"); ax[0].text(3.4,3.4,"z = 3",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax[0].set_xticks(range(4)); ax[0].set_xticklabels([k.replace(" (","\n(").replace(", ","\n") for k in order],fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman z-score vs shuffled-query null")
ax[0].set_title("bll6423 against 1001 reviewed cupin-superfamily\nproteins (UniProt, IPR011051)",fontsize=10)
top=df.head(16).iloc[::-1]
ax[1].barh(range(len(top)),top["z"],color=[cols[c] for c in top["class"]])
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(top)))
ax[1].set_yticklabels([f'{n[:44]}  ({a})' for n,a in zip(top["name"],top["acc"])],fontsize=8)
ax[1].axvline(3,ls="--",lw=1,color="k")
ax[1].set_xlabel("z-score"); ax[1].set_title("Top 16 hits: every one above z = 10 is a\nvirC/oryJ-clade cupin with no annotated cofactor",fontsize=10)
for i,k in enumerate(order): ax[1].scatter([],[],color=cols[k],label=k)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(df.head(20)[["acc","name","cof","z","class"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nbest metal-dependent cupin: z = %.1f (%s)"%(df[df.cof.str.len()>0].z.max(), df[df.cof.str.len()>0].iloc[0]["name"]))
print("gap (top virC-clade z minus best metalloenzyme z) = %.1f sd"%(df.z.max()-df[df.cof.str.len()>0].z.max()))
